bill.title: Prohibits agreements intended to conceal certain information concerning development of data centers under MLUL.

posted_text:
🏢 NJ S4304 — Data Centers Face New Scrutiny: NJ Limits Secret Deals

New Jersey is cracking down on data center development. This bill stops developers from using non-disclosure agreements with local officials and property sellers – deals that could hide crucial information about these facilities. If a developer tries to use such an agreement, it’s automatically against public policy and won’t get them approval for a new site plan or subdivision. ...
